```yaml
name: Test Copilot GitHub Integration
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version-file: go.mod
        cache: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        go mod download
        go install github.com/onsi/ginkgo/v2/ginkgo@latest

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        go test -v ./... -timeout=30s

    - name: Run integration tests
      run: |
        go test -v -tags=integration ./... -timeout=60s

    - name: Verify generated files
      run: |
        # Check that instruction files are generated by default
        if [ ! -f ".github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md was not generated"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        if [ ! -f ".github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md was not generated"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "SUCCESS: Both instruction files were generated correctly"

    - name: Test --no-instructions flag
      run: |
        # Test that --no-instructions flag prevents file generation
        rm -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md
        rm -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md
        
        # Run compile with --no-instructions flag
        go run cmd/gh-aw/main.go compile --no-instructions
        
        # Verify files are not created
        if [ -f ".github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md was incorrectly generated with --no-instructions"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        if [ -f ".github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md was incorrectly generated with --no-instructions"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "SUCCESS: Files correctly skipped with --no-instructions flag"

    - name: Test --no-emit flag integration
      run: |
        # Test that --no-emit flag also skips instruction files
        rm -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md
        rm -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md
        
        # Run compile with --no-emit flag
        go run cmd/gh-aw/main.go compile --no-emit
        
        # Verify files are not created
        if [ -f ".github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md was incorrectly generated with --no-emit"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        if [ -f ".github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md was incorrectly generated with --no-emit"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "SUCCESS: Files correctly skipped with --no-emit flag"
```
